description:
Reply in a conversation

Sends a message into a chat conversation as a human agent, delivering it to the visitor over the same channel the thread runs on. An API key is not itself an agent session, so the message is attributed to the agent already assigned to the thread, or to the account's first live chat agent when it is unassigned. An account with no live chat agent at all cannot send and is rejected with 409. Chat threads only: a voice call id is rejected with 400. A thread whose state does not allow a reply, a closed one for example, is rejected with 412.

body.description: The reply text to deliver to the visitor. It may not be empty.

message.description: The text sent to the visitor as a human agent reply.
